docs.title: Immersive Aircraft Tech Compat
docs.text:
Immersive Aircraft Tech Compat is an addon designed to seamlessly bridge the gap between Immersive Aircraft and your favorite tech mods.

Say goodbye to carrying stacks of coal! This mod allows you to power your gyrocopters, airships, and biplanes using the advanced liquid fuels produced by your tech infrastructure.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
1. Install Immersive Aircraft.
  2. Install Fabric API.
  3. Drop the Immersive Aircraft Tech Compat .jar into your mods folder!

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Extensive Mod Support: Burn fuels from Tech Reborn, Oritech, and Modern Industrialization directly in your aircraft.
  • Reusable Fluid Containers: Don't want to carry individual buckets? No problem! This mod natively hooks into Fabric's FluidStorage API, meaning you can place fluid containers directly into the aircraft's fuel slot.
    • For example, Tech Reborn Tank Units are fully supported! The aircraft will intelligently sip fluid directly from the tank unit to fill its internal boiler, without consuming or deleting the tank item itself.
  • Highly Configurable: Fine-tune the burn time multiplier of every single fuel type to perfectly balance your modpack.

docs.title: Tested Environment
docs.text: The current stable build is tested against: - Minecraft 1.21.1 - Fabric Loader 0.16.14 - Fabric API 0.116.17+1.21.1 - Immersive Aircraft 1.5.2+1.21.1 - Oritech 1.2.12 - Tech Reborn 5.11.19

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: The mod generates a configuration file located at config/ia-fuel-compat.json. This file gives you fine-grained control over how the mod behaves, allowing you to seamlessly balance it for your modpack.

docs.title: Global Settings
docs.text:
"enabled": true,
  "debugLogging": false,
  "baseBurnTime": 1200
* enabled: Master toggle for the entire compatibility mod. Set to false to disable the mod entirely without uninstalling it. * debugLogging: Enable this if you are a modpack developer troubleshooting fuel detection or fluid extraction. * baseBurnTime: The baseline fuel value (in ticks) that fuel multipliers are applied against.

docs.title: Fuel Settings
docs.text:
Under the fuels section, you will find an entry for every supported fuel type across all integrated mods.

  "fuels": {
    "tr_nitro_diesel": {
      "enabled": true,
      "multiplier": 2.0
    },
    ...
  }
* enabled: Set to false to prevent this specific fluid from being used as fuel. * multiplier: Determines how powerful the fuel is relative to baseBurnTime. A value of 2.0 will provide twice as much burn time per bucket as a value of 1.0.

docs.title: Container Settings
docs.text:
"containers": {
    "buckets": true,
    "techrebornCells": true
  }
* buckets: Allows fluid buckets to be used in the aircraft's fuel slot (currently a placeholder for future generic bucket support). * techrebornCells: Toggle specific container integrations.

docs.title: Supported Fuels
docs.text:
The mod dynamically adds support for various high-efficiency liquid fuels. Below is a list of the currently supported fuels and their default multipliers.

What is a multiplier?

The multiplier determines how much fuel value the liquid provides compared to the default base burn time (which is 1200 ticks). A multiplier of 1.0 means one bucket is equivalent to the base burn time. 2.0 means it lasts twice as long.
